notes: Recently played on the listener page is now five songs, matching what's up next — a ten-deep history next to a five-deep future looked lopsided. Also in this release: your station's page starts playing as soon as someone opens it instead of waiting for the play button; shuffle is built as the station plays rather than fixed at the start; listeners can request a song; a playlist can follow a YouTube playlist; playlists can be renamed; song titles come from the music files themselves; Tools → Tidy up the gaps skips the silence between songs; and the app comes back to the station you were working on.
